summary: The diff correctly implements REQ-1 by updating `frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts` to include UPI as a payment method in the desktop Razorpay checkout configuration. The `buildRazorpayConfig` function now provides a desktop block that includes card, netbanking, UPI (with intent/collect/qr flows), and wallet methods. The mobile configuration retains UPI as well. The `isMobileDevice()` utility import is preserved and unchanged. All existing payment methods are retained in both configurations.
